ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability fit. This is a closed-form, multi-stage dividend discount model calculation with a single correct answer among given options — a reasoning/math task with clear completion criteria. Willet-235B posts meaningfully higher scores on the benchmarks that track this kind of quantitative reasoning (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 56.2, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2). The task-preference notes for both models don't favor one over the other here: Willet's distinctive trait is around distasteful content (irrelevant), and Lapwing's aversion to open-ended generative work doesn't apply since this is a structured problem (and that preference is explicitly noted as dissociated from capability anyway). So the deciding factor was Willet's stronger measured reasoning capability.
